verdict.rationale: mParticle's homepage says users can describe an audience in natural language and the product 'understands the customer data behind it' and 'suggests the logic to use'. That maps directly onto NL-to-segment generation grounded in the user's data. The only support is a one-line marketing claim, with no product documentation of the workflow. missing for 10: first-party docs describing the NL audience builder, evidence that the generated definition is presented for review/editing before saving, documentation of how it grounds suggestions in the actual schema/attributes, hands-on or independent corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can describe an audience in natural language and AI builds the segment definition for review, grounded in my actual schema

citations.quote: Describe the audience, journey, or growth goal. mParticle understands the customer data behind it, suggests the logic to use, and helps turn intent into revenue-driving activation.
